title: Kion Cloud Access Role
description: A cloud access role defines access permissions for users and groups to cloud accounts at the OU or project level, supporting AWS, Azure, and GCP IAM policies.

id.description: Internal Kion cloud access role ID.

web_access.description: Whether web console access is enabled.

short_term_access_keys.description: Whether short-term access keys are enabled.

long_term_access_keys.description: Whether long-term access keys are enabled.

aws_iam_policies.description: AWS IAM policy IDs attached to the role.

azure_role_definitions.description: Azure role definition IDs attached to the role.

gcp_iam_roles.description: GCP IAM role IDs attached to the role.

users.description: User IDs assigned to the role.

user_groups.description: User group IDs assigned to the role.

accounts.description: Account IDs the role applies to.

labels.description: Labels associated with the cloud access role.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the cloud access role was created.
